Research links higher congener levels to worse perceived hangover symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-kayKPIoVp0KukuWjaeHpF6h71jc9soyPYuSHD9u5KblPKBlHTxTvMwvHaJczraOyiInRW1tZiAOdIoydpGeaX9j9BaoRU9ZwzanhdINakZ0iNkCKIWky-E-hglxUQXAT9X4V6R772qmHQuAae-ZfzsGXYLrfR74TDsuLSofwANwOJ_v_N53WJ9lFE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1_INUQaz_3vL0ZfuwzZViJiY8dux6H_son1vlq-wuFBSpTPJfY9BhF0azbHMetQUgXMKSVfJ7eqEDhm_uW_PRaSDhOzNTDFg3U62GpT6liaVpiNK3mvT_q4Jh0MCs6CQscB-LpadsrggVMiydHB0bNw7Wn9HfeQVzGQrHOSzRgiCgonkwXY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF132-gMMpf_9HJC3Ri2Q-zY5qibghks42xdH-QyDvz_ESkPib3VfbbQAYWqRkf-kOx_miA3WkVM9am0FPd1j2os1TplBSXWDblsAL94qDhAPXX9OH7DK6X4SC9LLWZmcPK59EBFgj-aFiwxl7x9iMoBVR9u3Y606hE6gw2fIpqspM)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1wYU-5E92aRVvhqeVfvAUKsYUmP0ovDx8ZIT_dFtaLBjQXFQ6xCt2XcmRmIPvHVSpFq3hvWVXGh7MvMYaDHz701oGu7b_U9HhI0_koxpkUTg3omq88LXCOt1YU-E9ZU98lo947BfoRu39XyMqEQlggymJIWUxbdoKJr1KdTQnWAYFBSBab7lfmKqT81ubkH9phHT_EtALAw9)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0AEBxCJF18dQcdQiCC9uE1K_I2_B0SvPmZ__cUjuP16vUX_ullLLoWltjxHogjVKmTdkxS22B9Kz-hDV9eAg3tBliiRpnL8TuGshpd1b-EOSH0iuSSv69VDoJilkWtkUGMCFtEZu0BY4ezNaWScimHLFdCFl8y18oo42hapg-9WwIsXBdZJkNIAfoMkDQ7PAy3eyWmhNlbJPkj83LGnxVIlC2qsQEGEsuKXdw0Ex_f_ftjY4JGpxdoen3UeULhksUYc0ozifQqotmpINqjZXMDA0)

### How to Recover and Prevent One

- **Rehydrate steadily:** Drink water or electrolyte fluids to replace lost fluids.
- **Eat bland foods:** Toast, crackers, or broths can help settle an irritated stomach and stabilize blood sugar.
- **Rest and give it time:** Only time clears alcohol and its byproducts from your body; there is no proven quick cure.
- **Pace and alternate next time:** Drink slowly, alternate with water, and avoid heavy drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF11BTCtNIvXCtb4y_CnzYFn0omhZ4CLLxei-w32gH4Ln37ue-xgiSDfL1a5nw2fqFIUUAVprmIupKRT-3JcyUDycHTzKR2Hh0nF4naSgzOYDWik_68S1IlYl_SB8CByvrNB0Sl-qSd4QTCkk4AuG0ybuBedU--xCQ4WNT4lw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1_INUQaz_3vL0ZfuwzZViJiY8dux6H_son1vlq-wuFBSpTPJfY9BhF0azbHMetQUgXMKSVfJ7eqEDhm_uW_PRaSDhOzNTDFg3U62GpT6liaVpiNK3mvT_q4Jh0MCs6CQscB-LpadsrggVMiydHB0bNw7Wn9HfeQVzGQrHOSzRgiCgonkwXY)
